description: After preventing Apophis’s invasion, SG-1 discovers the Tok’ra, a resistance of symbiotes opposed to the Goa’uld, and Earth gains its first major off-world alliance. The team also encounters the Asgard more directly as new enemies and technologies widen the scale of the war.

s02e01.description: Trapped aboard Klorel’s ship as the Goa’uld fleet reaches Earth, SG-1 attempts to destroy the vessels from within before the planet is attacked.

s02e02.description: Carter becomes host to a Tok’ra symbiote during a rescue mission, revealing for the first time that not every Goa’uld symbiote is an enemy.

s02e03.description: SG-1 is sentenced to a brutal prison world and must rely on an enigmatic inmate to escape through a Stargate nobody else can use.

s02e04.description: A virtual-reality keeper traps SG-1 inside painful memories, forcing each member to relive events they most want to change.

s02e05.description: Daniel falls under the influence of a princess and a sarcophagus while the rest of SG-1 is forced into labor in her father’s mines.

s02e06.description: SG-1 returns to Cimmeria during a Goa’uld invasion and searches for the Asgard protection promised by Thor.

s02e07.description: An apparently ancient alien artifact brought to Earth begins spreading through Stargate Command and reveals an unexpected form of life.

s02e08.description: Teal’c returns to Chulak after Apophis kidnaps and brainwashes his son, turning a family rescue into a test of loyalty.

s02e09.description: Daniel returns to Abydos and discovers the pregnant Sha’re, while political pressure on Earth threatens to expose the Stargate program.

s02e10.description: An alien insect infects Teal’c and begins transforming him, forcing him to hide from the authorities while SG-1 searches for a cure.

s02e11.description: Memories left in Carter by Jolinar lead SG-1 to the hidden Tok’ra, where Earth seeks an alliance against the Goa’uld.

s02e12.description: The Tok’ra alliance hinges on finding a new host for Selmak, giving Carter’s dying father Jacob a choice that changes both his life and Earth’s war.

s02e13.description: SG-1 investigates a missing mining team and discovers that the supposedly simple inhabitants guarding valuable trinium are not what they appear.

s02e14.description: A stolen weather-control device leads SG-1 to evidence that a secret Earth organization has its own access to the Stargate.

s02e15.description: An Ancient device fills O’Neill’s mind with knowledge he cannot contain, pushing him toward a destination beyond Earth’s known gate network.

s02e16.description: A gate connection to a planet falling into a black hole traps Stargate Command in extreme time dilation and threatens to pull Earth apart.

s02e17.description: An elderly alien scientist uses a machine to exchange bodies with Daniel, leaving SG-1 to untangle a rapidly spreading chain of swaps.

s02e18.description: A dying, tortured Apophis asks Earth for sanctuary, forcing SG-1 to balance justice, intelligence value and the threat of his new enemy Sokar.

s02e19.description: After an unmanned probe damages an alien ecosystem, SG-1 discovers that its seemingly simple inhabitants are becoming sick because of Earth’s arrival.

s02e20.description: An engineered child arrives at the SGC warning that invisible Reetou rebels plan to destroy humanity to deny the Goa’uld future hosts.

s02e21.description: A Stargate anomaly throws SG-1 back to 1969, where they must trust a young George Hammond and find a path home without wrecking history.

s02e22.description: O’Neill awakens in a supposed future SGC and slowly realizes his captors are using his memories to identify races capable of defeating the Goa’uld.
